runner: run_xiaomi_libero.py: the run_trial loop of Xiaomi-Robotics-0 eval_libero/main.py with its deploy/client.py Client; model in scripts/xiaomi_policy_server.py (deploy/server.py for several clients)
env_seed: a new env per trial with env.seed(7); np.random.seed(7) once; per-query seed hashed from the inputs
max_steps: episode_lengths per suite if set, else --env.episode_length in the extra flags if set, else LeRobot defaults (spatial 280, object 280, goal 300, libero_10 520)
note: Xiaomi-Robotics-0-LIBERO, one policy for the four suites (README: 98.7); transformers 4.57.1 on Python 3.10 / torch 2.7.1 (README: Python 3.12 / torch 2.8.0); exceptions are re-run instead of counted as failures
policy_settings: as stored in the checkpoint (policy_config.json) unless overridden by the extra flags
